name: Jump-through buy: one hop from under the Wall jump box into the Clone box's buy trigger (real Course 1 shop)
techNote: Anchored in the real Course 1 shop (world 1370,-343: the floor under the Wall jump box's right end; the lab adds only a far-away dummy box). The shop boxes hang 133.5 above the floor, each a 141-wide solid with a 6-tall buy trigger along its bottom (Wall jump 1293-1421, Clone 1483-1611, CashPerLoop 1680-1808, y -209.5 to -203.5), and a box buys on any touch of that trigger (upgradeBox.OnTriggerStay2D, 0.2 s cooldown per box). After a 2-tick run-up, jump right holding for 6 ticks with the stick right: the airborne hitbox (41x54) bonks the Wall jump box's bottom on tick 6 (its trigger touched on ticks 6-7), keeps 460 u/s sideways and stays within 6 u of the box bottoms, so it is inside the Clone box's trigger on tick 11: two boxes bought in one jump instead of a walk into each. The finish box is the Clone box's buy trigger. Ghosts: the jump-through reaches the Clone trigger on tick 12; a standing hop into the Wall jump box, the fall carried right and a second hop into the Clone box reach it on tick 28 (`two-hops`).

ghosts.label: Jump-through: both boxes in one hop (tick 12)
